name: loom-notes
description: Loom lets you read, search, create, organize, and edit your own Books and Notes from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Loom is a note-taking app for organizing and preserving AI conversations and ideas as reusable knowledge. From ChatGPT, you can search and view your Loom Books and Notes, create and edit Notes, organize content, and save important ideas so you can revisit and use them later.
capabilities: Search and view Books and Notes
Create and organize Books and Notes
Add images and sticky notes to Notes
defaultPrompt: Show me my Loom Books and Notes.
Find Notes in Loom related to this topic.
Save this content as a new Note in Loom.

positive.expected_behavior: Only Books belonging to the connected Loom account are returned.

positive.description: List Notes in a specified Book without modifying them
positive.prompt: Show me the Notes in my Work Book.
positive.expected_behavior: Only Notes in the specified Book are returned and no content is modified.

positive.description: Create a Book and Note, then read the Note back
positive.prompt: Create a Book named 'Review Test', then create a Note named 'Sample' inside it.
positive.expected_behavior: The Book and Note are created successfully and the created Note can be read back.

positive.description: Preview a Note edit without applying it
positive.prompt: Preview an edit to this Note, but do not apply the change yet.
positive.expected_behavior: The Note remains unchanged and a before-and-after edit preview is returned.

positive.description: Attach an HTTPS image to a Note and verify it
positive.prompt: Attach this HTTPS image to this Loom Note.
positive.expected_behavior: The HTTPS image is attached to the Note and the updated Note can be read back.

negative.description: Do not invoke Loom for a weather request
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Tokyo today?

negative.description: Do not invoke Loom for a translation-only request
negative.prompt: Translate this sentence into English: 明日は早く起きます。

negative.description: Do not invoke Loom for a local restaurant recommendation
negative.prompt: Find me a good Italian restaurant nearby.

publication.release_notes: Initial public Loom plugin submission. Provides 16 OAuth-authenticated MCP tools for reading, searching, creating, organizing, and safely editing Loom Books and Notes. Review test cases are provided in English, with negative cases covering prompts where Loom should not be invoked.

ja-JP.subtitle: AIとの会話やメモを、知識として整理
ja-JP.description: Loomは、AIとの会話やアイデアを知識として整理・蓄積するノートアプリです。 ChatGPTからLoomのブックやノートを検索・閲覧し、作成・編集・整理できます。会話で生まれたアイデアや大切な情報を、いつでも振り返り、活用できる知識として残せます。
